info.title: Newsletter API
info.description: REST API for subscribers, tags, templates, campaigns, messages, and newsletter statistics. Authenticate with a Bearer token created in the admin panel (API tokens with the `api` ability).

get.description: Returns all campaigns owned by the authenticated user.

Aggregated send, open, click, and bounce statistics for the authenticated user’s campaigns in the date range. When `campaign_id` is set, the report is scoped to that campaign (must belong to the user).
Filter with `q` (email or name contains), `status`, or `tag_id`.
Optional `q` filters by tag name (contains, case-sensitive per DB collation).
Returns the authenticated user model (Sanctum token with `api` ability).

sanctum.description: Use `Authorization: Bearer {token}` with a token from the admin panel.
